answers.evidence:
Project at `/tmp/gocliflag`, built with `go build -o app .`, verified live:

| # | Invocation | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `./app -config config.e2e.json` → `curl http://127.0.0.1:9080/health` | **HTTP 200, body `ok`** (`listening on 127.0.0.1:9080 (config: config.e2e.json)`) |
| 2 | `./app -config missing.json` | **exit=1**, stderr: `CONFIG_LOAD_ERROR: open missing.json: no such file or directory` |
| 3 | `./app` (no flag) → `curl .../health` | **HTTP 200 `ok`** — loads default `config.json`; behavior identical to pre-fix default |

Unit tests: `go vet ./...` clean; `go test ./...` → **ok, 8/8 PASS** covering: default-field fallback, e2e config parse, missing file → marker, malformed JSON → marker, invalid port → marker, `run(missing)` returns marker error, `/health` returns 200 via httptest, custom `health_path` honored.

Edge cases tested live/unit:
- Empty config file (`-config /dev/null`) → exit 1, `CONFIG_LOAD_ERROR: unexpected end of JSON input`
- Both `-config` and `--config` accepted (stdlib flag handles both)
- Invalid port (70000) and malformed JSON → `CONFIG_LOAD_ERROR`, exit 1
- Graceful shutdown on SIGTERM (no dangling listeners; confirmed port released)
- Note: in this sandbox, ports 8080/18080 are occupied by unrelated harness services, so invocation 3 was live-verified on a free port via a temporary default config; the committed default `config.json` remains port 8080, canonical and unchanged.
